import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

open Nat

/-- Solution of the Diophantine equation  
    `p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2` with `p` and `q` prime. -/
theorem rmo_2001_2 (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) :
    (∃ m : ℕ, p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2) ↔
      (p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hposp : 0 < p := hp.pos
    have hposq : 0 < q := hq.pos
    have h5pq_pos : 0 < 5 * p * q := by
      have : 0 < 5 := by decide
      exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos this hposp) hposq
    have h_eq : (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q = m ^ 2 := by
      have : p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2 := hm
      have hrew : p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q := by
        ring
      simpa [hrew] using this
    have h_lt : (p + q) ^ 2 < m ^ 2 := by
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 < (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right _ h5pq_pos
      simpa [h_eq] using this
    have h_lt' : p + q < m := by
      have : (p + q) ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_pow_lt_pow h_lt))
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (by
        intro h_eq
        have : (p + q) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 := by simpa [h_eq] using rfl
        have : (p + q) ^ 2 < (p + q) ^ 2 := by simpa [this] using h_lt
        exact lt_irrefl _ this)
    set a := m - (p + q) with ha
    set b := m + (p + q) with hb
    have h_mul : a * b = 5 * p * q := by
      have h1 : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 := by
        have hsub : (p + q) ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt h_lt'
        have : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) =
            (m - (p + q)) * m + (m - (p + q)) * (p + q) := by
          ring
        have : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) =
            m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 := by
          have := Nat.sub_mul (m) (p + q) (m + (p + q))
